description: Metabase Dashboard Configuration for Scooter Rental DWH

dashboards.name: Scooter Rental Analytics
dashboards.description: Main dashboard for scooter rental business metrics

native.query: SELECT sum(total_revenue) as total_revenue FROM aggregated_metrics WHERE metric_date >= today() - 30
SELECT sum(orders_count) as orders_count FROM aggregated_metrics WHERE metric_date >= today() - 30

cards.name: Users Count
cards.description: Count of unique users who made orders

native.query: SELECT sum(users_count) as users_count FROM aggregated_metrics WHERE metric_date >= today() - 30

cards.name: Average Ride Duration
cards.description: Average duration of rides in minutes

native.query: SELECT avg(avg_ride_duration_minutes) as avg_duration FROM aggregated_metrics WHERE metric_date >= today() - 30
SELECT avg(avg_order_price) as avg_price FROM aggregated_metrics WHERE metric_date >= today() - 30
SELECT metric_date, sum(total_revenue) as revenue FROM aggregated_metrics WHERE metric_date >= today() - 30 GROUP BY metric_date ORDER BY metric_date
SELECT metric_date, sum(orders_count) as orders FROM aggregated_metrics WHERE metric_date >= today() - 30 GROUP BY metric_date ORDER BY metric_date
SELECT toHour(metric_tenmin) as hour, sum(orders_count) as orders FROM aggregated_metrics WHERE metric_date >= today() - 7 GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour
